main.description: A device enrolled in the mailbox (SPEC §4), physical or virtual. Personal mailbox space. rkey = hex(deviceKeyPubkey). Immutable except that revokedAt is set once on revocation.

epochStorageAuthKeyPubkey.description: Labyrinth HPKE auth key; absent for virtual devices.

virtual.description: True for a recovery (virtual) device, which has no epochStorageAuthKey.

chatBinding.description: [CB-36] Ed25519(chat key, "catbird.labyrinth.device_binding:" || did || ":" || deviceKeyPubkey) by the chat device that enrolled this physical device. Absent for virtual devices; a physical device without a valid binding to a current chat device is dropped at the next rotation.

revokedAt.description: Set once when the device is revoked; the revoking device opens a new epoch that excludes it ([CB-11]).
